subject: table: Non-clustered table non-unique global index needs partid in key, v1 (#65380)
summary: Adds `IndexInfo.GlobalIndexVersion` and updates global index key encoding/decoding so non-clustered, non-unique global indexes (and unique global indexes when NULL forces handle-in-key) include partition ID in the key via `PartitionHandle`, preventing key collisions after `EXCHANGE PARTITION`. Also updates pessimistic-lock unchanged unique-key generation to match the new key format and avoids nested `PartitionHandle` on decode.
